title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W3 stale-bounce gate is not chronological — same-day redelivered pre-correction bounces still exhaust and fabricate referee_contact_invalid
detail: at is RFC3339 T-separated; corrected_at::text is space-separated Postgres text (fractional, session-TZ). Same-day stale bounce: 'T' (0x54) > ' ' (0x20) at byte 10 sorts the pre-correction send AFTER corrected_at, so it is judged genuine and exhausts with a fabricated referee_contact_invalid. Tests only use cross-day fixtures (2026-08-01 vs now()).
recommended_fix: Compare chronologically in SQL (e.g. e->>'at'::timestamptz vs corrected_at) or normalize both sides to identical RFC3339 UTC strings before string.compare; add a same-day stale-bounce test.

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W8 late-response guard never checks the route — stale ApiReturnedRefcheckAction still toasts on a non-detail page
location: client/src/client.gleam:3522-3537 (guard) + 6584-6599 (find_refcheck_call) + 651 (application_detail reset only on entering the detail route)
detail: find_refcheck_call reads model.application_detail, which persists after leaving the detail route (reset to Loading only when entering one). A stale response still finds the call and toasts on the wrong page; only the refetch is route-guarded (refetch_refcheck_effect).
recommended_fix: Gate on the route too: toast/refetch only when model.route is the matching ApplicationDetail(vid, aid), or when call_id is still in refcheck_action_inflight.
